processDefinition.name: tenant-b-report-pipeline
processDefinition.description: Athena 聚合查询 → Redshift 报表写入 → 行数校验

taskDefinitionList.name: athena-daily-aggregation
taskDefinitionList.description: Athena 聚合 tenant-b processed 分区数据，输出到 S3 报表路径

taskParams.sql: SELECT DATE(event_time) AS report_date, COUNT(*) AS total_events, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM tenant_b_events WHERE DATE(event_time) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

taskDefinitionList.name: redshift-insert-report
taskDefinitionList.description: 将聚合结果写入 Redshift 报表表

taskParams.sql: INSERT INTO tenant_b_daily_report (report_date, total_events, total_amount, created_at) SELECT CURRENT_DATE - 1, COUNT(*), SUM(amount), SYSDATE FROM tenant_b_events WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE - 1;

taskDefinitionList.name: validate-report-rows
taskDefinitionList.description: 校验今日报表行数不为零

taskParams.sql: DO $$ DECLARE cnt BIGINT; BEGIN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO cnt FROM tenant_b_daily_report WHERE report_date = CURRENT_DATE - 1; IF cnt = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No report rows found for %', CURRENT_DATE - 1; END IF; END $$;
